title: Chang Chi

page_data.en:
No
889
14/6/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
June 12th 1916.

Sir,

A great number of the ex-members of the Parliament
dissolved by Yuan Shih Kai are at present in Shanghai.
Most of them inhabit the French Concession where they
are in the habit of holding private meetings about
three times each week.

They are generally in favour of supporting Li
Yuan Hung, the present President and are advocating the
bringing into line of the provinces which have
declared themselves independent of the Central Government.

Chang Chi 张  ̶ ̶ the ex-President of the Upper House
is taking a very prominent part in these discussions.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmmmmming
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on 12 June 12
OK
page_data.zh:
编号
889
16/6/14
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）
1916年6月12日。

先生：

目前有许多被袁世凯解散的国会前议员身处上海。他们大多居住在法租界，并习惯于每周举行约三次私人会议。

他们普遍倾向于支持现任总统黎元洪，并主张使那些宣布脱离中央政府的省份重新归顺。

参议院前议长张继（Chang Chi）在这些讨论中扮演着非常突出的角色。

您忠实的仆人，

mmmmmmmmming
总探长。

警察总监。

录入于6月12日
核准
